# HexPiece 2.5.6

The first-person draw and sheathing, rebuilt, and a real temper on every blade but Yoru. Nothing here has been tested in game yet;
the build's checks pass. Everything from 2.5.5 is in here too.

## First person: drawing and sheathing the sword
- **The draw:** your left hand goes to the saya's mouth and your right hand comes up to the handle. The thumb breaks the seal with a
  glint, then the blade slides out along the saya's curve while the left hand pulls the saya back. As the point leaves the mouth,
  the blade whips across the view and settles in your hand. It is timed to the game's own draw, so the blade leaves the saya at the
  same moment it does in third person.
- **The sheathing:** a flick to clean the blade, then it swings back and lays its back at the saya's mouth. It slides home slowly
  until the guard meets the mouth, and the hands go back to rest on the hilt.
- **Holding it drawn, between cuts:** the blade rises from your right hand, with your arm running up from below the screen to the
  handle. The arm no longer swings through the camera.
- **Yoru:** drawn, it comes down over your right shoulder into your hand, and it goes back up the same way.
- Both arms are the game's own, so your skin, Armament's black and Ryou's aura show on them. Armament blackens the blade as it does
  in third person. Anything in your off hand keeps the left hand busy.

## A real temper on the blades
- **All 25 katanas and Gryphon** have their blades repainted with a proper temper. The hardened edge is frosted and misty, the
  temper line glows softly with fine sparkling crystals along it, and faint streaks run from it toward the edge. The rest of the
  steel shows its folded grain flowing along the blade.
- **Each blade keeps its own temper line**, the exact shape you painted: zigzags, waves, square teeth or straight. Your colours stay
  the same.
- **Gryphon** had no temper painted, so it gets irregular rounded waves along its edge.
- **Yoru is unchanged.** Your original textures are untouched; the new ones are built from them.

## Please test
- Draw and sheathe a katana in first person, standing and walking, and between cuts. Check whether it looks right to you.
- Look at a few blades up close: the temper line, the frost and the grain.
- Still to check from 2.5.4 and 2.5.5: the free head in sword animations, the hand on the sheathed sword, the Haki slash's
  30-second cooldown, and the white screen (it should be gone).
